info.title: cabuya.org public API
info.summary: The three public, authless endpoints cabuya.org serves.
info.description:
Every endpoint here exists and is reachable. This document deliberately describes nothing else.

There is no authentication anywhere in it, and that is a design decision rather than an omission: every read is public, and a service that fetches arbitrary URLs on request is a far more attractive target if it also holds a credential.

The contact form endpoint is intentionally absent. It is a human form with a honeypot, a minimum fill time and a rate limit; documenting it as an API would invite exactly the automated submission those measures exist to stop.

post.summary: Validate a published manifest or feed against the specification
post.description:
Fetches the document at the given URL and runs the published validator's schema, semantic and person-level-data passes over it.

Runs in degraded mode: the transport passes are skipped rather than run against nothing, so the response reports findings but does not assert a measured conformance level. Reporting a level without the transport checks would be the overclaim this project exists to avoid.

Nothing is retained. The document is fetched, checked and discarded with the request.

url.description: Absolute https URL of a Cabuya manifest or place feed. Refused if it resolves to a private, loopback or link-local address.

lang.description: Language of the human-readable `message`, `rule` and `fix` in each finding. Check ids never translate.

200.description: The run completed. A conforming document and a failing one both return 200 — the verdict is in the body, not the status.

400.description: The body was not JSON, or the URL was rejected by the address guard.

429.description: Rate limited, per caller and per target host. The per-host limit protects the publisher being checked, not this service.

get.summary: Measured conformance state for every registry publisher
get.description: What the validator last found, per publisher, with the timestamp of the run. A publisher with no entry has not been measured — absence is reported as absence, never as a pass or a fail.

200.description: A map of publisher id to measured state.

get.summary: Conformance badge for one publisher, as SVG
get.description: Renders the same measurement `/registry/status.json` reports and links back to the publisher's registry page, so anyone can check it. It refuses to say more than the validator measured, and it never says certified.

404.description: No such publisher in the registry.

Finding.description: One check's result. Every finding locates the problem and states the correction.

id.description: Stable check id. Never translated, never renamed — a retired check keeps its id and is marked.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer to the offending member, when the check has one.

spec.description: Anchor in the normative text. Stable.

docs.description: The check's entry in the published catalogue.
